description: This file defines the TestsService class which manages test lifecycle operations such as starting, stopping, and retrieving status of tests, using an in-memory simulation and external repositories.

classes.name: TestsService
classes.description: Service for test lifecycle control (in-memory simulation).

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestsService with a tests repository.

methods.name: _get_or_404
methods.description: Retrieves a test status by ID, returns None if not found.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new test run, immediately updates status to 'running', and returns acceptance response.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops an existing test run, marks it as completed or failed, and returns acceptance response.

methods.name: get_status
methods.description: Retrieves current status of a test run, simulating completion if running for over 60 seconds.
